info.name: stock-analyser
info.description:
Stock Analyser API — technical analysis, AI commentary, and OpenAI key validation.

lookbackDays guide:
  250  = ~1 year  (minimum — SMA200 barely covered, NOT recommended)
  500  = ~2 years (acceptable)
  750  = ~3 years (RECOMMENDED — reliable SMA200, Golden/Death Cross, full cycle coverage)

item.name: Analyse Stock — 3 Years WITH AI Commentary (recommended)

request.description:
Runs full technical analysis on 3 years (~750 trading days) of historical data.

Why 750 days?
- SMA200 needs at least 200 candles — 1 year (250 days) is the absolute minimum and leaves zero buffer.
- Golden Cross / Death Cross (SMA50 vs SMA200) requires enough history to detect the crossover reliably.
- 3 years covers at least one full bull+bear market cycle, making indicators significantly more trustworthy.

Fields:
- symbol              : NSE stock symbol (e.g. INFY, RELIANCE, TCS)
- lookbackDays        : 750 = ~3 years of trading days (RECOMMENDED)
- includeAiCommentary : true → GPT-5.5 commentary appended to result

item.name: Analyse Stock — 3 Years WITHOUT AI Commentary

request.description: Same as above (3 years of data) but skips the OpenAI call — faster response, works without a valid API key.
500 trading days = ~2 years. Acceptable for SMA200 but misses broader market cycle context.

item.name: Analyse Stock — 1 Year (minimum, use with caution)

request.description: 250 trading days = ~1 year. MINIMUM threshold — SMA200 is barely covered with zero buffer. Stocks with missing/holiday gaps may not qualify for SMA200 at all. Not recommended for trend analysis.

Returns the current OpenAI API key validation status as evaluated at application startup.

Response fields:
- keyValid            : true/false — whether the key was accepted by OpenAI
- validationMessage   : VALID | INVALID_HTTP_401 | INVALID_HTTP_429 | VALIDATION_ERROR | MISSING_OR_EMPTY_KEY_FILE | NOT_VALIDATED
- aiCommentaryEnabled : mirrors keyValid — tells callers if AI commentary will be generated
- checkedAt           : ISO-8601 timestamp of when the status was last read

The key is validated once at startup via GET https://api.openai.com/v1/models with the loaded key.
